name: Argentina
fact: Celebrated worldwide for dramatic flair, Argentine tango originated in Buenos Aires dance halls and continues to captivate global audiences as an esteemed UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

name: Bolivia
capital: Sucre (constitutional; La Paz seat of government)
fact: The celestial expanse of Salar de Uyuni, spanning ten thousand square kilometers, transforms into Earth's largest natural mirror whenever seasonal rainwater blankets the pristine white salt flats.

name: Brazil
fact: An Atlantic sanctuary of dramatic volcanic peaks, Fernando de Noronha protects teeming coral reefs, resident spinner dolphins, and vital nesting grounds for endangered sea turtles.

name: Chile
fact: Astronomers worldwide gather in the Atacama Desert to utilize world-class optical and radio observatories, benefiting from some of the clearest nighttime skies on Earth.

name: Colombia
fact: More than nineteen hundred distinct bird species thrive across Colombia's diverse Andean ecosystems and Amazonian rainforests, making it the most bird-rich nation on Earth.

name: Ecuador
fact: Because of the planet's equatorial bulge, the snow-capped summit of Mount Chimborazo represents the closest terrestrial point on Earth to the sun and outer space.

name: Guyana
fact: Surrounded by vast untouched rainforest, the majestic Kaieteur Falls plunges over two hundred meters in a single breathtaking drop, creating one of the world's most powerful waterfalls.

name: Paraguay
fact: Colossal hydroelectric installations on the Paraná River allow Paraguay to generate virtually all of its domestic electricity from clean, renewable energy.

name: Peru
fact: Machu Picchu showcases extraordinary fifteenth-century Inca engineering high along an Andean ridge, where interlocking granite stones stand in perfect harmony without mortar.

name: Suriname
fact: Dense tropical canopy carpets more than ninety percent of Suriname's territory, establishing it as the planet's most heavily forested nation and a carbon-negative haven.

name: Uruguay
fact: Pioneering digital education worldwide through Plan Ceibal, Uruguay became the first nation to equip every public school student with a personal laptop and wireless internet connectivity.

name: Venezuela
fact: Plunging from the towering cliffs of Auyán-tepui in Canaima National Park, Angel Falls drops nearly one thousand meters as Earth's tallest uninterrupted waterfall.
